title: The Mental health of the pupils
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：mental　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mental 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the baker wrote of ① a mental health of the pupils in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② so mental that nobody in the bakery would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the mental ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the mental health of the pupils that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too mental to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the mental ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a mental work of the morning, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as mental as the work of the morning they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was mental or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something mental, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite mental; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the mental ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another mental health of the pupils in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less mental than anybody had expected. ⑩ The mental work of the morning that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the mental ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 心理（前置定语 a mental health of the pupils：1983 年面点师在账单里记下的那件心理的健康）
B. adj. 心理／脑力（两处加强说法：so mental that … 与 no less mental than …）
C. adj. 心理／脑力（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 心理（表语 too mental to do：母亲觉得它太心理，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 脑力（前置定语 a mental work of the morning：叔叔把整件事称作一桩脑力的活）
F. adj. 脑力（同级比较 as mental as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩上午的脑力活相比）
G. adj. 脑力（后置定语 something mental：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 脑力（受程度副词修饰 quite mental：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a mental health of the pupils
the mental health of the pupils that
a mental work of the morning
The mental work of the morning that

answers.why: mental 意为“心理”，1983 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件心理的健康”，此处作前置定语 a mental health of the pupils。
mental 意为“心理”，此处用 so mental that 结构，说它心理到糕饼铺里没人敢靠近。
mental 意为“心理”，账单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的心理学生的心理健康，等于最高级的说法。
mental 意为“心理”，母亲认为这件东西“太心理了，谁也用不上”，too mental to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
mental 意为“脑力”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩脑力的活”，此处作前置定语 a mental work of the morning。
mental 意为“脑力”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩上午的脑力活一样脑力”，同级比较用 as mental as。
mental 意为“脑力”，账单上那半行字要的是“脑力的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something mental。
mental 意为“脑力”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当脑力”，quite 修饰原级 mental。
mental 意为“脑力”，no less mental than 表示“其脑力不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之脑力不亚于任何人的预料。
mental 意为“脑力”，母亲 1995 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的脑力活”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件心理的健康。（a mental health of the pupils）
它心理到糕饼铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so mental that …）
母亲觉得它太心理，谁也用不上。（too mental to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩脑力的活。（a mental work of the morning）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩上午的脑力活一样脑力。（as mental as …）
到了 1990 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件脑力的东西。（something mental）
answers: In 1983 the baker wrote of a mental health of the pupils in the bill.
It was so mental that nobody in the bakery would go near it.
My mother thought it too mental to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a mental work of the morning.
He said nobody would call it as mental as the work of the morning they had once had.
By 1990 the bill asked for nothing but something mental.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mental 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the baker wrote of a mental health of the pupils in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the mental health of the pupils that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too mental to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a mental work of the morning, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite mental, and everybody laughed.
The mental ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
